entities.summary: Nguyễn Gia Thiều, courtesy name Quang Thanh (光聲), pen name Đạm Trai (澹齋), formal title Ôn Như hầu (溫如侯), was a Vietnamese poet in the 18th century. He was the grandson of Trinh Cuong, who feigned madness when Nguyen Hue expelled the Trinh from Ke Cho.
